steps.title: measure your own delay
steps.body:
Every phone and every input has its own delay between your finger and the sound. Calibration measures yours: a click plays for 2 bars, you tap along 16 times, and the median offset becomes your correction.

- Calibrate each input you use: touch, and the Field's keys.
- Do it again on a new phone, and whenever timing feels off.
- Set the Field's velocity off first (Shift+Tempo: off). The drills score placement, not velocity.
